mentions.name: Dice of Sending
mentions.description: A hardware project that lets players roll physical dice during online D&D sessions, for when you want to roll physical dice while playing D&D online.
mentions.problem: Players who play D&D online cannot roll physical dice.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on Dice of Sending - for when you want to roll physical dice but you play DND online. This is mostly just for fun with my DND group.
